title: •Nizuc Bek
caption: •Nizuc Bek (V)
game_text: Whenever opponent Force drains at a non-battleground, may retrieve 1 Force. During your deploy phase, may ▼ an Effect with “matching” in game text. Once per turn, may place Juri Juice from hand on Force Pile to cancel a Force drain.
lore: Guard from Corulag. Former bouncer at the Mos Eisley cantina. Assigned by Jabba to guard celebrities visiting Jabba’s palace. Friend of Wuher. Loves juri juice.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 1, third box blank; deploy 1 / forfeit 3 (printed 3 / 2). Icon column: warrior (blue box, blaster), as on the printed card. Alien. Slip prints ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; curly double quotes around “matching”. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Jabba’s (wiki straight); no bold words visible ('Guard'/'bouncer' are not on the bold list). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1998 not legible.
